title: Subscription plans and feature limits

requirements.text: Features are allowed per plan; unknown features and unknown plans deny
Quantity limits (seats, projects) are checked against current usage; a limit the plan omits is zero
Canceled, unpaid and past-due-beyond-grace accounts fall back to a declared plan
Per-account negotiated overrides apply only while the account's own plan applies
Plan and status come from verified billing-provider events, never from the request
Concurrent creations cannot exceed a limit (usage counted and checked in the creating transaction)
Request handlers enforce the checks and return an upgrade-required response the UI can show
